description: Source code for LegacyWiFiManagerAPIs class implementing WiFi management functions, event handling, and JSON RPC method registration for network management.

classes.name: Job
classes.description: A dispatchable job class that executes a provided function.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the WiFiManager, sets up dependencies, and subscribes to events.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Cleans up resources, unregisters methods, and resets the instance.

methods.name: registerLegacyMethods
methods.description: Registers JSON RPC methods for WiFi management.

methods.name: clearSSID
methods.description: Removes known SSID from the list.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Connects to a specified WiFi network.

methods.name: getConnectedSSID
methods.description: Retrieves the currently connected SSID information.

methods.name: getPairedSSIDInfo
methods.description: Retrieves info of the connected SSID.

methods.name: saveSSID
methods.description: Saves an SSID to known list.

methods.name: startScan
methods.description: Starts WiFi scan with optional filters.

methods.name: retrieveSSID
methods.description: Reads SSID info from wpa_supplicant.conf file.

methods.name: initiateWPSPairing
methods.description: Starts WPS pairing with optional PIN.
